mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions, which typically support corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 245.0 signals elevated inflation, which typically triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 245.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 145,000) combined with weak housing demand (HOUST < 1,250) signals a potential economic slowdown, as robust job growth without corresponding housing activity may indicate cooling consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 145000 and HOUST < 1250, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market prices in aggressive rate hikes and recession risks.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, CPIAUCSL > 245.0, and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) reflect robust consumer demand and construction activity, which typically support corporate revenue growth and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 1250, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 104.0 indicates a contraction in industrial output, signaling weakening economic momentum and potential recession risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 104.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 470,000) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicates a resilient consumer economy that can absorb monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 470000 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak economic growth regime (GDPC1 < 16,800), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) signals a deepening slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 < 16800, INDPRO < 104.0, and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
